action: Connect one secure WebSocket client with a valid certificate and a foreign username, then read the client detail.
config:
[listeners.wss]
enabled = true
bind = "127.0.0.1:28884"
cert_file = "${TLS_DIR}/server-cert.pem"
key_file = "${TLS_DIR}/server-key.pem"
verify = "verify_peer"
cacertfile = "${TLS_DIR}/ca-cert.pem"
peer_cert_as_username = "cn"
